name.gu: ઘઉંનો ગેરુ રોગ (પીળો અને કથ્થઈ ગેરુ)
name.hi: गेहूं का रतुआ रोग (पीला और भूरा रतुआ)

causal_agent: Puccinia striiformis (Yellow rust) / Puccinia triticina (Brown rust)
symptoms: Yellow rust produces bright yellow pustules arranged in distinct continuous linear stripes along leaf veins
Brown rust produces small oval orange-brown scattered pustules on upper leaf surfaces without linear arrangement
When touched with fingers, yellow or orange powdery spores adhere to fingertips
lookalikes: Leaf blight (Alternaria/Bipolaris) which forms necrotic grey-brown lesions rather than powdery pustules
favourable_conditions: Cool humid weather (10-18°C for yellow rust; 15-25°C for brown rust) with dense morning fog and dew
season_or_growth_stage: Tillering to grain filling stage (December to February)
monitoring_and_confirmation: Scout lower leaves during cold foggy mornings; look for stripe pattern and touch test
prevention: Grow rust-resistant varieties like GW-322, GW-366, HD-2967
Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer which creates lush succulent foliage
cultural_management: Timely sowing before November 20 to avoid late season high-temperature rust epidemics

organic_options.treatment_name: Butter milk (Chhash) spray with sour curd fermented extract
organic_options.preparation_or_formulation: Fermented sour buttermilk (5 days old) diluted 1:10 with water
limitations: Mild fungistatic effect only at initial onset; ineffective under severe rust outbreak

chemical_options.dilution: 15 to 20 ml per 15-liter spray pump (200 ml per acre in 200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: Spray immediately on observing first linear yellow pustules in field
mixing_warnings: Do not mix with concentrated foliar fertilizers.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

chemical_options.dilution: 15 ml per 15-liter spray pump (150-180 ml per acre in 200 L water)
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

resistance_management: Alternate between triazole fungicides; plant genetically diverse resistant cultivars.
expert_referral_conditions: Contact local KVK agronomist or Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551) if infestation exceeds threshold.
